variants.label: Section list
variants.notes: Sections on the left split into You (Appearance, Language, Terminal, Notifications) and This server (sign-in, web server, plugins, hosts, with a lock for admins-only). One section at a time, saves instantly with an Undo toast. Settings opens from the new gear in the sidebar, above your avatar.

variants.label: One long page
variants.notes: Everything on a single scrolling page with a big search and an “On this page” index. Server settings show their config key under each control. Settings opens from the new gear in the sidebar, above your avatar.

variants.label: Personal / Server
variants.notes: Two big tabs. Server changes queue up and show the exact diff for /etc/quadro/quadro.conf before you apply them. Settings opens from the new gear in the sidebar, above your avatar.
